loading.description: Loading spinner message while the scan API processes the image

cameraTab.description: Mode toggle tab label for camera scanning

searchTab.description: Mode toggle tab label for text search

cameraModeLabel.description: Accessibility label for the camera mode toggle button

searchModeLabel.description: Accessibility label for the text search mode toggle button

searchPlaceholder.description: Placeholder text for the book title/author search input. 'John Adams' and 'McCullough' are proper names — keep them.
searchPlaceholder.notes: Proper nouns must not be translated

searchInputA11y.description: Accessibility label for the search text input

searchButtonA11y.description: Accessibility label for the search submit button

searchButton.description: Label on the search submit button

permissionText.description: Explanatory text shown when camera permission is not granted

allowCamera.description: Button label to request camera permission

allowCameraA11y.description: Accessibility label for the allow camera button

captureA11y.description: Accessibility label for the camera shutter button

captureHint.description: Accessibility hint explaining what the capture button does

noBooksFoundTitle.description: Alert title when scan returns no book matches

noBooksFoundMessage.description: Alert message prompting user to try again after empty scan result

scanFailedTitle.description: Alert title when the scan API call fails

scanFailedMessage.description: Alert message for a scan API failure

noResultsTitle.description: Alert title when text search returns no results

noResultsMessage.description: Alert message prompting user to try a different search query

searchFailedTitle.description: Alert title when the search API call fails

searchFailedMessage.description: Alert message for a search API failure

addedTitle.description: Alert title confirming a book was added to the wishlist

addedMessage.description: Alert message confirming which book was added. {{title}} is the book title.

couldNotSaveTitle.description: Alert title when saving to wishlist fails

couldNotSaveMessage.description: Alert message for a wishlist save failure

flipCamera.description: Short label on the button that flips between front and back camera

flipCameraA11y.description: Accessibility label for the flip camera button

takePhoto.description: Label on the web camera button that opens the device camera to scan a book cover

queueFull.description: Error banner shown when the offline scan queue has reached its 50-scan limit and a new capture is rejected

pendingUploads.description: Badge on the scan screen showing how many scans are waiting to upload; {{count}} is a number

usageToday.description: Counter on the scan screen: scans left today (daily allowance). {{count}} is a number.

usageNoMatch.description: Counter on the scan screen and in Settings, under the scans-left counter (#577): how many more photos where no book could be recognised are allowed today without using a scan. {{count}} is a number.

noBooksFoundFree.description: Banner after a scan found no book (#577): says this photo did not use one of today's scans. Short: shown in at most two lines beside an action button, so the counters on the scan screen carry the detail.

noBooksFoundCounted.description: Banner after a scan found no book (#577) when this photo did use one of today's scans. Short: shown in at most two lines beside an action button, so the counters on the scan screen carry the detail.

dailyLimit.description: Shown when the daily scan limit is reached. Keep 'UTC' and keep {{time}}, the reset time in the user's local time.

requestsDailyLimit.description: Shown when the user has made the most scan requests allowed today (new photos and repeats both count; #586). Different from dailyLimit. Keep {{time}}, the local time the limit resets (UTC midnight).

stillProcessing.description: Neutral message when the server is still working on the user's previous scan after silent retries.

scanPaused.description: Neutral message when scanning is temporarily unavailable server-side. Not an error the user caused.

dismissNotice.description: Button that dismisses the scan notice card

tryAgainNotice.description: Button on the scan notice card that retries the refused scan

queueFullLimited.description: Error banner when the offline queue is full while scanning is limited or paused; saved photos are sent later. No upsell.

sendPendingNow.description: Button next to the pending-uploads badge that sends the waiting scans now

enhancedRequiresPremium.description: Info banner when a user who is not Premium asks for an enhanced scan (enhanced scans are Premium-only). Keep 'Premium' as the product name. No upsell.

enhancedThrottled.description: Info banner when enhanced scans are paused for the user because several recent enhanced scans found no books. Keep {{time}}, the local time enhanced scans are allowed again. Not an accusation.

enhancedThrottledLater.description: Same as enhancedThrottled, when the time enhanced scans are allowed again is unknown.

repeatAlreadyHaveOne.description: Info banner (#588) when the user re-sends a photo already scanned and its one book is already in their library.

repeatAlreadyHaveMany.description: Info banner (#588) when the user re-sends a photo already scanned and all its books (two or more) are already in their library. No number is shown, so this is a fixed plural, not an i18next count plural.

repeatNotInLibrary.description: Banner (#588) for a photo scanned before whose books are not all in the library (rejected, deleted or not saved). Ends with a question; the Re-add button sits beside it. Re-adding uses the saved result.

repeatReAdd.description: Button on the repeat-photo banner (#588): opens the earlier results so the user can add the books again. One short word.

repeatNoMatch.description: Banner (#588) for a photo scanned before in which no book was found. Suggests a clearer photo or another angle. The user is not charged, but do not mention scans or charges.

scanFailedFinal.description: Error banner (#604) when a photo still failed after every automatic retry because the scanner was unavailable. Tells the user to tap the banner's Retry button (scanFailedFinalRetry; use the same word) to try again. Do not mention deleting or the queue: the banner's View queue button (scanFailedFinalViewQueue) covers that. Not the user's fault.

scanFailedFinalRetry.description: Button on the final scan failure banner (#604): sends the photo again now and restarts its automatic retries. One short word.

queueTitle.description: Title of the scan queue screen: lists photos waiting to be scanned and photos that failed

queueBack.description: Button at the top of the scan queue screen that goes back to the previous screen. One short word.

queueWaitingTitle.description: Section heading on the scan queue screen for photos waiting to be scanned

queueWaitingEmpty.description: Empty state under the waiting section of the scan queue screen when no photo is waiting

queueFailedTitle.description: Section heading on the scan queue screen for scans that failed

queueFailedEmpty.description: Empty state under the failed section of the scan queue screen when no scan has failed

queueFailedNote.description: Note under the failed-scans heading: failed scans stay on the phone for 7 days and are then removed automatically. Keep the number 7.

queueStateWaiting.description: State of a queued photo that cannot be sent yet because the phone is offline or the scanner is paused

queueStateNextTry.description: State of a queued photo that will be tried again automatically; {{time}} is a local time of day such as 3:45 PM

queueStateSending.description: State of a queued photo that is being sent to be scanned right now

queueFailedAt.description: Line on a failed scan saying when it failed; {{time}} is a local date and time such as Oct 22, 2026, 3:45 PM

queueRetry.description: Button on a failed scan: sends the photo again now and restarts its automatic retries. Use the same word as scanFailedFinalRetry. One short word.

queueDelete.description: Button on a failed scan: deletes the scan and its photo from the phone. One short word.

queuePhotoA11y.description: Screen reader label for the thumbnail of a photo in the scan queue

viewQueue.description: Button on the scan screen's pending-uploads badge that opens the scan queue screen

scanFailedFinalViewQueue.description: Second button on the final scan failure banner (#604): opens the scan queue screen where the failed photo can be retried or deleted. Same wording as viewQueue.

queueDeleteConfirm.description: Confirmation shown before a failed scan is deleted from the scan queue screen. Says the scan will be deleted and its photo removed (permanent). Two short sentences, a question then a statement.

queueDeleteCancel.description: Cancel button in the delete-scan confirmation. One short word.

queueRetryA11y.description: Screen-reader label for a failed scan's Retry button. {{time}} is the date and time the scan failed, so each row's button is distinct. Use the same word for retry as queueRetry.

queueDeleteA11y.description: Screen-reader label for a failed scan's Delete button. {{time}} is the date and time the scan failed, so each row's button is distinct. Use the same word for delete as queueDelete.

queueRowA11y.description: Screen-reader label that reads a queue row's photo and state as one item. {{what}} is the photo label or the search text; {{state}} is the row's state text. Keep the placeholders and the colon-style separator.

viewQueueFailed.description: Link on the scan screen, shown when only failed scans exist (nothing waiting), that opens the scan queue screen. {{count}} is the number of failed scans.

alreadyInLibraryMessage.description: Banner after adding one book that was already in the user's library, so nothing was added. {{title}} is the book title.

alreadyInLibraryManyMessage.description: Banner after adding several books that were all already in the user's library. {{count}} is the number of books (2 or more).

addedAndOwnedMessage.description: Banner after adding books when some were added and the rest were already in the user's library. {{added}} and {{owned}} are counts.
